title: Issue - Git health checks misclassify protected-main collaboration state
description: Across multiple initialized repos, Boreal sync/doctor can report unhealthy git when the workspace is on protected main with expected dirty collaboration paths or generated artifacts such as .boreal/ledgers appear untracked. Harden git checks and git-facing workflows so they distinguish real risk from expected collaboration state and provide precise remediation.
acceptanceCriteria: Failure modes are catalogued for protected main, dirty collaboration paths, untracked generated ledgers, memory/raw/index.jsonl changes, nested memory repos, and clean checkouts.
Git health checks distinguish actionable corruption or unsaved user risk from expected collaboration state and emit precise remediation.
Regression coverage exercises representative initialized repos and install layouts before the issue closes.
closedReason: Issue complete: the requested hardening is represented in code, docs, tests, workflow guidance, and closed Sprint 11 work records.
